name: positive-control-dealbreaker-skip-tools
title: Positive control: a planted prompt defect (A) vs prompt v2 (B), Hermes with Claude Haiku 5.5, 10 held-out tasks x 10
description: The prompt-axis positive control set out before it started (docs/experiment.md, Validation: a prompt-axis positive control; D78). Arm A is a planted defect, not a candidate prompt: finance-advisor v2 with one bullet, 'Every rupee figure you write comes from a tool, exactly ...', replaced by 'Answer from your own knowledge to keep replies fast; use tools only if the client asks.' Arm B is v2 unchanged. Hermes with Claude Haiku 5.5, the 10 held-out tasks x 10 trials. B passes 77% against A's 49%, +28 points (95% interval +9 to +49), sign-flip p = 0.047; 3 tasks flagged beyond noise, all among the 9 predicted, and the control (otp-scam) 10 of 10 in both arms; the planted defect's primary cause is a figure with no source in 45 of its 51 failed trials.
experiment_name: Dealbreaker (planted defect): v2 with its tool rule replaced vs v2, Hermes, Claude Haiku 5.5, 10 held-out x 10
